name: Shantou Institute of Ultrasonic Instrument Co., Ltd.
summary: Shantou Institute of Ultrasonic Instrument Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of medical imaging equipment and non-destructive testing equipment in China. The company offers color doppler ultrasound, SIUI MAI, B/W, veterinary, and X-ray imaging systems. It also offers non-destructive testing equipment, such as flaw detector, thickness gauge, and probes and accessories. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Shantou, China.
